content: The alert indicates a high-severity data exfiltration event from a critical asset (Database-Server-03) to an untrusted external IP (203.0.113.45). A significant amount of data (100MB) was transferred over port 443 (HTTPS). The high confidence (0.95), classification (data_exfiltration), and MITRE T1020 (Automated Exfiltration) mapping suggest a credible and urgent threat. The NIST control SC-8 (Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity) is directly violated. This requires immediate, high-priority investigation.
